validation.upgrade: Installed over 1.4.4; an earlier title, Croatian text, and legacy sketch remained intact after saving the notebook in format 3.
validation.notes: Speech fixtures live only in the test APK. They supply English/Croatian words, RMS levels, short phrase endings, silent timeouts, and continuous segments. Tests verify automatic continuation, exact accumulated words, manual finish without restart, erase-all including pending results, lifecycle cleanup, and sound feedback in both orientations. Physical-phone acoustic accuracy and provider availability were not tested. Drawing checks use real page touch gestures, rendered pixel comparisons for erasing, colors and thickness, undo/redo, movement, size/rotation/opacity controls, transparency, placement behind text, disk persistence and activity recreation. Existing notebook/pagination/alignment flows also pass. All six voice flows were rechecked after the voice-only fixes; the ready-state fixture window was lengthened for the final waveform recheck. Test APK and temporary provider selection were removed after checks.
